what_this_is: a clean-PATH subprocess environment, not a container

delta_and_the_finding_that_forced_it.limb: the receipts pin a digest of a Windows binary
evidence: the three prover/verifier-verdicts/*.lean4.json record environment.platform = win32
delta_and_the_finding_that_forced_it.consequence: a Linux container runs a different binary with a different digest, so a re-check inside one cannot confirm the recorded pin: it would be a re-check of different receipts, not a colder re-check of these ones
limbs_withdrawn_as_wrong: external_verifier.py:196-217 is NOT Windows-bound — it selects lean.exe on nt and lean elsewhere
the NEVER-downloads rule in that docstring binds that function, not a Dockerfile
delta_and_the_finding_that_forced_it.stated_plainly: this harness is weaker than a container, and every SURVIVES it publishes is scoped to that weaker exclusion

steps.name: capture the pin table
steps.detail: already done, in CR-P0: session_ledger.pins() lives under scripts/ and imports serve_chat and write_stage, so after the rename it cannot run (§6's C4 ordering repair). experiments/cold_registry_census.json carries it.

steps.name: digest the working tree
steps.detail: a recursive sha256 over the repository, excluding .git, .venv, .worktrees, cold/ and the renamed tree. Taken before the rename and again after the restore. write_stage's own working_tree_byte_identity check cannot do this — it lives under scripts/.

steps.name: build the bundle outside the repository
steps.detail: the files the kind's receipt names, copied to a temporary root outside the repository root, with a bundle_manifest.json carrying each file's sha256 and size.

steps.name: rename the program tree away
steps.detail: scripts/ -> scripts.renamed-away-by-cold-harness. Rename rather than deletion, because it is reversible and the audit can prove it happened. An import is then an error and not a silent fallback.
steps.known_reversible_side_effect: the working-tree digest is disturbed while the rename holds
steps.restore_path: the rename is undone in a finally block and the tree is re-digested against the pre-rename value; a mismatch is a harness failure reported as such, never absorbed

steps.name: construct the environment
steps.detail: PATH reduced to the explicitly listed dependency directories; PYTHONPATH empty; PYTHONHOME unset; PYTHONNOUSERSITE set; cwd inside the bundle.
steps.interpreter: sys.base_prefix's python, run with -S -I: it sits outside the repository root, and -S -I keeps every site-packages (and therefore the repository's own .venv) off the child's sys.path

steps.name: write path_audit
steps.detail: two assertions, not one — see path_audit_asserts below

steps.name: run the arms
steps.detail: per-kind verdicts, then B3 tamper, B4 omission, B5 sham, B6 scramble, B7 removal, B11 provenance

steps.name: restore and re-digest
steps.detail: undo the rename, re-take the working-tree digest, and publish the comparison

path_audit_asserts.why_two: §1's own exhibit is scripts/replay_session.py:69-71, which reaches scripts/ through Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] and sys.path.insert. No PATH setting anywhere would have stopped it, so PATH alone is not the audit (§6's C2 repair).
path_audit_asserts.assertion_1: scripts/ is unresolvable — an import of a known program module raises, with the traceback quoted
path_audit_asserts.assertion_2: no sys.path entry resolves inside the repository — the subprocess dumps its own resolved sys.path and every entry is shown to lie outside the repository root, alongside PATH's entries with their listing digests, and every invoked dependency's resolved path and sha256

b8_remedy_delta.draft_wording: B8 >=90% SURVIVES on first run voids pending audited-empty-PATH re-execution
b8_remedy_delta.replacement: re-execution under a path_audit carrying BOTH assertions above
b8_remedy_delta.why: the draft's remedy was written for the container §6 rejects; against a rename harness an empty PATH proves nothing about the leak vector that actually exists

environment_kept_and_why.TEMP/TMP: the procedure writes its probe to a temporary directory, redirected inside the bundle
environment_kept_and_why.USERPROFILE/HOMEDRIVE/HOMEPATH: §11's L3 records that Path.home() reads these and that the constructed environment does NOT clear them; a reduced PATH is irrelevant to it. Kept and disclosed rather than cleared and claimed.

not_excluded: any system-wide Python and its site-packages
not_excluded_note: named here so no reader has to find it. A container would exclude most of this list. This one does not.

files.harness/cold_harness.py: the orchestrator: bundles, rename, arms, restore
files.harness/probe_recheck.py: the program-absent rechecker for the one kind CR-P1 published a rule for
files.harness/path_probe.py: the subprocess that writes path_audit's evidence
